# Downloadable skill packages

Each `.zip` here is one ready-to-upload Claude Skill. To use one:

1. Download the `.zip`.
2. In Claude, go to **Settings → Capabilities → Skills → Upload skill**.
3. Select the `.zip`. Done.

| Skill | Download |
|-------|----------|
| AI Product Roadmap | [`ai-product-roadmap.zip`](ai-product-roadmap.zip) |
| AI Unit Economics & Pricing | [`ai-unit-economics.zip`](ai-unit-economics.zip) |
| Enterprise AI Coach (EU) | [`enterprise-ai-coach-claude.zip`](enterprise-ai-coach-claude.zip) |
| AI Search Optimization | [`ai-search-optimization.zip`](ai-search-optimization.zip) |
| Enterprise AI Security | [`enterprise-ai-security.zip`](enterprise-ai-security.zip) |
| **All five in one file** | [`ai-product-playbook-all-skills.zip`](ai-product-playbook-all-skills.zip) |

Prefer the command line? This repo is also a Claude Code plugin marketplace — see the
[main README](../README.md#option-b--one-command-in-claude-code).
